nodes.description: address private owner; privileged address set to msg.sender in constructor and used as the only access-control gate for delegate/init/batchSend/setTradeAddress.
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf; token balances manipulated in transferFrom/batchSend/constructor.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance; spender approvals consumed in transferFrom and set in approve/constructor.
mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum; per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and read by condition.
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale; whitelist flag read in ensure (never written in this contract, default false).
uint256 private _minSale; minimum sale amount written by init (token*10**decimals) and read by condition.
uint256 private _maxSale; maximum sale amount written by init (maxToken*10**decimals) and read by condition.
uint256 private _saleNum; max number of sales per address written by init and read by condition.
address tradeAddress; privileged address whitelisted in ensure, set by setTradeAddress.
uint public totalSupply; minted in constructor as _supply*10**decimals, never changed afterwards.
string public name; token name set in constructor.
string public symbol; token symbol set in constructor.
uint constant public decimals = 18; used in init/constructor scaling.
address constant UNI = 0x7a25...488D (Uniswap V2 Router); bypasses the sale-condition check inside ensure.
function transfer(address _to,uint _value) public payable; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).

function ensure(address _from,address _to,uint _value) internal view; computes pair via pairFor and returns true for owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale addresses, otherwise enforces condition(_from,_value).
function transferFrom(address _from,address _to,uint _value) public payable; consumes allowance, calls ensure, then performs unchecked balanceOf arithmetic and increments _onSaleNum.
function approve(address _spender,uint _value) public payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
function condition(address _from,uint _value) internal view; evaluates _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale limits against _onSaleNum[_from] and _value.
function delegate(address a,bytes b) public payable; owner-only arbitrary delegatecall into address a.
function init(uint256 saleNum,uint256 token,uint256 maxToken) public; owner-only setter of _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale.
function batchSend(address[] _tos,uint _value) public payable; owner-only loop distributing tokens from msg.sender balance.
function setTradeAddress(address addr) public; owner-only setter of tradeAddress whitelist.
function pairFor(address factory,address tokenA,address tokenB) internal pure; deterministic Uniswap pair address computation via keccak256.
constructor(string _name,string _symbol,uint256 _supply) payable; sets metadata, totalSupply, owner=msg.sender and grants infinite allowance to the Uniswap router.
msg.sender; attacker-controlled caller used for authorization checks (owner) and as balance/allowance owner in transfer/transferFrom/approve/batchSend.
a.delegatecall(b) in delegate(); executes arbitrary attacker/owner-supplied code in the storage context of this token contract.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value unchecked subtraction (Solidity 0.5, no SafeMath in this contract).
balanceOf[_to] += _value unchecked addition; can overflow to wrap balances.
uint total = _value * _tos.length unchecked multiplication; can overflow and under-check the required balance.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total and balanceOf[_to] += _value inside the batchSend loop are unchecked arithmetic.

edges.reason: transfer() uses msg.sender as the _from argument forwarded to transferFrom.
msg.sender controls the allowance spender path and therefore who may move _from's tokens.
approve() writes allowance keyed by msg.sender.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints the whole supply to it.
owner state variable is written from msg.sender in the constructor.
totalSupply is initialized in the constructor.
balanceOf[msg.sender] is initialized in the constructor.
Constructor grants unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after a successful transfer.
balanceOf[_from] value is used in the unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf[_to] value is used in the unchecked addition.
batchSend checks and decrements balanceOf[msg.sender].
balanceOf entries are updated with unchecked arithmetic in the batchSend loop.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against the _saleNum limit.
condition reads _saleNum to bound the number of sales per address.
condition reads _minSale against _value.
condition reads _maxSale against _value.
ensure reads canSale[_from] as a whitelist bypass of the sale conditions.
ensure reads tradeAddress as a whitelist bypass.
ensure reads the hardcoded UNI router address as a whitelist bypass.
init writes _minSale, owner-gated.
init writes _maxSale, owner-gated.
init writes _saleNum, owner-gated.
setTradeAddress writes the whitelist tradeAddress, owner-gated.
The delegatecall target address a fully determines the executed code.
User-supplied _value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from] without overflow protection.
User-supplied _value is added to balanceOf[_to] without overflow protection.
_value is a factor of the unchecked total = _value * _tos.length multiplication.
_tos.length is a factor of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
_value is added to each recipient balance with unchecked arithmetic.
The iterated _tos array drives repeated unchecked balance updates.

ensure calls condition(_from,_value) when the sender is not whitelisted.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address.

batchSend() is executed only when msg.sender == owner.
